At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia launches ‘massive’ attack on Ukraine
items.description: Russia’s Defence Ministry says its forces carried out a 'massive strike' on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions.

items.title: How NATO Plans to Win: ‘Theory of Victory’ Against Russia to be Unveiled in Poland
items.description: NATO’s top commander in Europe will unveil a strategy for defeating a potential Russian attack on the alliance’s eastern flank. The plan draws on Ukraine’s war experience, emphasizing low-cost drones, AI targeting and rapid strikes on Russian command systems.

items.title: Israelis mourn on the anniversary of the Oct. 7 as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
items.description: Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, attack that killed 1,200 people, and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that Palestinians still grapple with.

items.title: At least two killed in fire caused by 'massive strikes' on Kyiv
items.description: At least two people were killed in a fire in Kyiv after what President Volodymyr Zelensky described as"massive strikes" on the Ukrainian capital on Wednesday. Ukraine has come under increased attack in recent weeks as Russian attacks have targeted energy infrastructure and rail and road transport.

items.title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
items.description: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

items.title: Anche il reclamo delle Malvinas al centro dell'omaggio a Messi
items.description: L'inno cantato da un veterano della guerra e verrà spiegato lo striscione del mondiale

items.title: United in anti-US sentiment, Iran and Russia forge solidifying partnership
items.description: Deepening ties between Iran and Russia are paying off for both powers, especially on the battlefield.

items.title: EU seeks ways to make expansion more palatable to members
items.description: The European Commission has put forward ideas it hopes will both ease the EU expansion process and allay concerns among existing members. Several countries, not least war-torn Ukraine, are among the candidates.

items.title: 2 Killed in Massive Ukrainian Drone Attack on Moscow
items.description: Exiled outlet Astra also reported that one of the attacks targeted the Moscow region’s largest fuel storage hub.

items.title: Three years after October 7: Despite pain, two former Hamas hostages promote message of peace
items.description: Among the 251 Israelis taken captive by Hamas on October 7, 2023, Aviva and Keith Siegel chose to speak publicly about the abuse they suffered. While Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has claimed the release of hostages as an achievement in his election campaign, the couple in their 60s has continued to oppose the war.

items.title: Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan
items.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) has strongly condemned a deadly airstrike on two clearly marked aid trucks in South Kordofan, Sudan, this past weekend.

items.title: Ukrainian Singer Returns Home From US To Perform For Ukrainian Soldiers Near Front Line
items.description: After studying at Berklee and building a career in New York, Ukrainian singer Valeriia Vovk returned home to perform for troops, including near the front. She says simply being there, talking to soldiers and singing for them, has great value.
